title: Decode string
statement: Decode strings of the form k[encoded], meaning encoded repeated k times; encodings nest. Example: 3[a2[c]] → accaccacc. Input is valid; k ≥ 1 may have several digits.
hints: Nesting means a stack: on '[' save what you had and the repeat count; on ']' restore and repeat.

solution.explanation: A stack of (string so far, repeat count) frames. On '[' push and reset; on ']' pop and set current = saved + current × k. Multi-digit counts accumulate digit by digit.
